title: Zoom Connects Live Instruction, Video Learning, and Engagement Insights for Higher Education
summary: Zoom Classroom, an upgraded LTI app, is now generally available in the U.S., while Zoom Video Management 2.0 can help institutions...
body_markdown:
Today at the 2026 EDUCAUSE Annual Conference, Zoom announced the general availability of Zoom Classroom for U.S. customers, a new AI-first application that brings Zoom’s collaboration tools directly into learning management systems (LMS) that support the LTI® 1.3 standard. Zoom also introduced Zoom Video Management 2.0, which helps give institutions new ways to create, organize, discover, and measure video-based learning.


Together, these offerings are able to connect more of the higher education experience, from scheduling and delivering live classes to sharing course content, reviewing recordings, and understanding student engagement. By bringing these workflows closer to the LMS and the learning experience, Zoom can help educators spend less time managing disconnected tools and more time focused on teaching and student success.


Additionally, educators can leverage Zoom’s AI-first Zoom Rooms and Meetings experience on Cisco hardware. Native Zoom Rooms are expected to be available on a wide range of compatible Cisco devices, with additional hardware support on the way, letting educators and staff maximize their existing equipment investments.


**Updated Zoom LTI App**


Zoom’s new LTI app, Zoom Classroom, offers enhanced, more powerful integration with Learning Management Systems. Available today on the


[Zoom Marketplace](https://marketplace.zoom.us/apps/dg22Z3cjRbyDirqg6txCKQ) , the new application supports:


- Blackboard


- Canvas by Instructure


- D2L Brightspace


- Moodle


- And other LMS platforms compatible with LTI 1.3.


Within their LMS courses, instructors can:


- Schedule one-time or recurring Zoom Meetings


- Share Zoom Whiteboards, Zoom Canvas docs, and Zoom Clips on course pages, in discussions, and in assignments


- Create assignments and have the submitted grades automatically synchronize to the LMS gradebook.


Zoom intends to continue to build functionality on top of Zoom Classroom by adding other first-party solutions such as Zoom Video Management, Docs, Whiteboard, Scheduler, and more. Administrators can simplify deployment through LTI 1.3 dynamic registration and manage access through role-based controls and administrator-defined permissions.


**Enabling Video Learning To Be More Discoverable and Measurable**


Once a class ends, the learning continues through recordings and other on-demand video content. Zoom Video Management 2.0 helps institutions turn that content into a more useful and measurable part of the learning experience.


New, improved video analytics give faculty and administrators visibility into views, completion rates, engagement scores, and trends across content. These insights can help educators understand what students watched, where they stopped engaging, and which materials may benefit from additional instructional support.


Expanded branding and a new AI Content Studio experience can also make it easier for institutions to create polished, campus-branded videos without needing to rely on third-party software. Institutions can share branded video portals across websites, intranets, and the LMS, allowing for a more consistent experience for students, faculty, and staff.


For eligible plans, Zoom AI can help make video content easier to navigate and more accessible through capabilities like automatic transcription, translated captions, AI-generated smart chapters, and intelligent search across video transcripts. Students can quickly find the portions of a lecture or presentation they need to review without scrubbing through an entire recording.


**Built Around the Needs of Higher Education**


“At Brandeis University, we’ve built our campus communications around the Zoom platform. From Zoom-ready classroom AV systems, Zoom Phone, Contact Center, and Virtual Agent, it has simplified how the entire campus communicates,” said Eli Jacobson, Sr. Associate Director, Network Communications & Digital Media at Brandeis University. “Zoom Video Management is the natural next step for us. The ability to organize, search, and measure video content in one place is something our community has been asking for, and we’re excited to explore what it can do.”


“Zoom has become a core part of how we deliver personalized learning at JLA. By bringing our classrooms, video, communications, and AI capabilities into one connected platform, we can focus less on managing technology and more on creating innovative learning experiences,” said Joaquin Infante, Chief Technology Officer at Jewish Leadership Academy. “More than a technology provider, Zoom has been a true partner in helping us reimagine the classroom of the future.”


“Higher education institutions need technology that supports the full learning journey, from live instruction and collaboration to on-demand content and engagement insights,” said Johann Zimmern, Global SLED Marketing Lead at Zoom. “With Zoom Classroom and Zoom Video Management 2.0, we’re helping institutions bring these experiences together in the tools educators and students already use.”


**Zoom Earns EDUCAUSE Higher Ed Ready™ Designation**


Zoom has earned the EDUCAUSE Higher Ed Ready™ designation, recognizing technology providers that have demonstrated a sustained commitment to the distinct needs of higher education through a rigorous application and third-party assessment.


“EDUCAUSE is pleased to recognize Zoom as part of the first cohort to earn the Higher Ed Ready designation. This recognition reflects Zoom’s demonstrated commitment to understanding and serving the distinct needs of higher education, and we appreciate their early participation in helping shape the program as it launched,” said John O’Brien, Ph.D., President and CEO, EDUCAUSE.


“Earning the EDUCAUSE Higher Ed Ready™ designation reflects our ongoing commitment to understanding the needs of higher education and building solutions that support teaching, learning, and student success,” continued Zimmern.


Learn more and visit the Zoom Education team at


[Educause](https://click.zoom.com/educause_2026) in booth #1013.
